R3-1: closed — the payment-record discount is struck; the settlement's fourth factor is a hardship-cause share read from the borrower's active Larkspur hardship plans, so only a borrower in hardship (for whom the base names early closure as the Credit Builder's hardship route) gets any closing-interest relief, and the settlement again carries four factors.
R3-2: closed — the re-enrollment due-day reset is a declared, scoped overwrite of the base due-day sentence with its reason; a reset that moves the day stays in the same month; a zero buffer or the day-28 cap leaves the due day and next due date unchanged; an account with an amount past due keeps its due day and next due date.
R3-3: closed — the late fee is owed only for the oldest unpaid due date (and not again once that due date carries its fee) and the returned-payment fee only for the most recent returned payment, each narrowing stated in its policy's declared overwrite and matching the waits that depend on it.
